## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a conventional commit (`feat(orchestrator): …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] `mise run generate` run; generated files committed
- [ ] No change to existing step text, the orchestrator's API, the notification contract, the dispatcher SDK or CLI output, **or** an ADR is included
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] AI-assisted (a human reviewed every line)
